newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt says seeks up to 45,000T assorted vegoils.
newsitem.headline: Egypt says seeks up to 45,000T assorted vegoils.

text.p: Egypt's official Holding Company for Food Industries said on Monday it was seeking up to 45,000 tonnes of assorted vegetable oils for delivery in May 1997.
Moharram Ghanem, head of the sales sector, told Reuters the deadline for all bids was noon (1000 GMT) on April 2 and that all shipments should be in bulk.
He said he was seeking the oils in the following lots:
-- 20,000 tonnes to 25,000 tonnes of semi-refined sunflower seed and/or cottonseed oil for delivery the first half of May.
-- 10,000 tonnes +/- 5 percent buyers option Malaysian or Indonesian palm oil for May delivery.
-- 5,000 tonnes to 10,000 tonnes of degummed soyabean oil for delivery in the first half of May
